_note: Constants of the energy model in scripts/experiments/energy.py that are not simulator inputs. The per-event energy coefficients of the DRAM array, the transfers, the PE operations and the DIMM-level buffers are the *_pj_per_* keys of config/pim/bitacc_runtime_default.json.

host.source: Assumed host power: 65 W while the host executes its own operations (embedding, LM head, sampling) and 10 W while it waits for the DIMM; 0 W and 20 W bound the idle power in the sensitivity study. These are assumptions of the paper (Section 6, Energy), not measurements.

pe_leakage.source: bank_pe_w, dimm_pe_w: leakage power of one bank-level PE and of the DIMM-level PE logic, Synopsys Design Compiler pre-layout synthesis with the ASAP7 7-nm RVT TT library (paper Table 'Area and power'). dimm_buffers_w: leakage of the 6+2+2 KiB DIMM-level buffers, CACTI organization model scaled to 7 nm with published FinCACTI ratios (same table).

ddr5_device.source: Maximum supply currents of one Micron 16-Gb DDR5 SDRAM die revision D, x8, DDR5-5600 speed grade (data sheet current specifications: precharge standby IDD2N/IPP2N/IDDQ2N, active standby IDD3N/IPP3N/IDDQ3N, all-bank refresh IDD5B/IPP5B/IDDQ5B). The same device is used for every model configuration, although the simulated organizations are 8-Gb to 32-Gb DDR5-3200 devices.
